message.content:
Here’s a list of the long weekends (public holidays that fall on a Friday or Monday, creating a three‑day weekend) in Canada for 2023:

| Date | Holiday | Day of Week | Notes |
|------|---------|-------------|-------|
| **January 1** | New Year’s Day | Sunday | (No long weekend) |
| **January 2** | New Year’s Day (Observed) | Monday | Observed because Jan 1 was Sunday |
| **February 20** | Family Day (Alberta, Saskatchewan, Ontario) | Monday | Long weekend in those provinces |
| **March 20** | Good Friday | Friday | (Long weekend) |
| **April 7** | Easter Monday | Monday | (Long weekend) |
| **May 22** | Victoria Day | Monday | (Long weekend) |
| **June 19** | Canada Day | Saturday | (No long weekend) |
| **July 1** | Canada Day | Saturday | (No long weekend) |
| **July 3** | Canada Day (Observed) | Monday | Observed because July 1 was Saturday |
| **August 7** | Civic Holiday (Ontario, New Brunswick, Prince Edward Island, Nova Scotia, Newfoundland & Labrador) | Monday | Long weekend in those provinces |
| **September 18** | Labour Day | Monday | (Long weekend) |
| **October 9** | Thanksgiving (Canada) | Monday | (Long weekend) |
| **November 10** | Remembrance Day (observed) | Monday | (Long weekend) |
| **December 25** | Christmas Day | Monday | (Long weekend) |
| **December 26** | Boxing Day | Tuesday | (No long weekend) |

**Key points for planning:**

- **New Year’s Day** is observed on Monday, January 2, giving a long weekend in all provinces.
- **Family Day** is a long weekend only in Alberta, Saskatchewan, and Ontario.
- **Good Friday** and **Easter Monday** create long weekends across the country.
- **Victoria Day** is a long weekend nationwide.
- **Canada Day** falls on a Saturday in 2023, so the observed holiday on Monday, July 3, creates a long weekend in provinces that observe it.
- **Civic Holiday** is a long weekend in several provinces (Ontario, New Brunswick, PEI, Nova Scotia, NL).
- **Labour Day**, **Thanksgiving**, **Remembrance Day**, and **Christmas** all create long weekends nationwide.

Feel free to let me know if you need the list broken down by province or any additional details!
